text:
Felipe Ramirez: hey everyone — Felipe here, joining as an inference infra engineer. First day today! quick setup q: i'm on an M1 mac, do I enroll in JAMF or is there a different flow? also super excited to join — fun fact: used to busk with a guitar in Lisbon :)

Priya Rao: welcome Felipe!! :tada: i'll set up a 1:1 and add you to the inference roadmap invites. ping me for any blocked access.

Zoe Liu: hi Felipe — i'm your onboarding buddy. welcome!! i'll DM a short list of Slack channels and the pairing schedule. coffee run at 10:30 if you want to step out :coffee:

Raj Kapoor: Felipe — thanks for the note. For Apple silicon macs, please enroll via JAMF. enroll link: https://mdm.redwood-internal/example/enroll. after enroll, request VPN token in 1Password (path: Teams/IT/VPN). if you hit any JAMF errors paste the error here and i'll triage.

Felipe Ramirez: thanks Raj — enrolling now. also, is there a recommended local dev command to test the runtime once i have keys?

Samir K.: welcome aboard! for local testing run `make dev-run` in the inference/runner repo and set `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`. there's also a samples/hello_stream.py to validate streaming. LMK if you need a test key.

Felipe Ramirez: perfect, i'll try that after JAMF. one more Q: where are the inference runbooks and oncall docs stored? couldn't find them in the obvious spot in the repo.

Maren Solis: welcome kit is en route :package: — stickers + plant! runbooks live in the monorepo under `docs/internal/inference` and mirrored into Confluence: https://wiki.redwood.com/inference/runbooks. If anything is missing, tag `#eng-runtime` and Samir will surface it.

Samir K.: i'll DM the onboarding checklist (includes env setup, sample tickets, and a small first PR). pairing session with Zoe on Wednesday to walk through the runtime trace flow.

Zoe Liu: heads-up — all-hands at 4pm today. there's a quick intro slot if you'd like to say hi to the whole company (totally optional).

Alex Chen: added Felipe to payroll & equipment tracker — you should see the laptop ETA in the tracker doc.

welcome-bot: Felipe Ramirez was added to the new-hires roster and scheduled for a 30-day onboarding check-in.

Felipe Ramirez: awesome, thank you all. excited to jump in. tiny fun fact redux: my go-to late-night warmup is a 7-chord jazz progression — if anyone plays guitar, let's jam sometime :guitar:
